_comment: E2E del arreglo de prompt-cache en la Responses API. Ejercita la forma TOOL-TAIL: el agente llama una tool real (current_time), asi que en el segundo turno del loop el ultimo item del input es un function_call_output — la forma que NO estaba verificada. Correr 3 veces seguidas con el mismo prefijo estable: el turno 1 escribe cache, los turnos 2 y 3 deben LEER. Si cached_tokens sigue en 0 en los turnos 2-3, el arreglo no sirve y no debe mergearse. Antes del arreglo esta misma grafica media write 2841 / read 0 en las 3 corridas.

config.system_message: Responde en UNA sola linea. PARENT STABLE CONTEXT, ignore it entirely. Colmena is a Rust-native AI agent orchestration library with a hexagonal architecture spanning domain, application and infrastructure layers, supporting OpenAI, Anthropic and Gemini behind a single LlmRepository trait. The DAG engine wires nodes declared in JSON; each node implements ExecutableNode and emits outputs under the output convention. Built-in nodes include sql_query, http_request, python_script, image_generation, image_edit, tts, suspend, secure_suspend, trigger_webhook, router, output_parser, subgraph, for_each and the orchestrator. Synthetic tools include the gsheets and gdocs families, sql_inspect_attachment, sql_bulk_insert_from_attachment, data_run_python, load_attachment, load_skill and describe_tool. Attachments flow through the OutputStorageRepository port and persist uniformly at registration. Skills load on demand via include_dir with YAML frontmatter. Lazy tool loading reveals schemas progressively through describe_tool. Conversational memory persists in Postgres keyed by agent_session_id. Secure values are encrypted at rest with pgcrypto. The orchestrator coordinates a planner, an executor, a critic loop and bridge tasks; subgraph nodes nest without a depth ceiling and HITL suspension propagates upward. Streaming SSE carries node-start, node-end and finish events. Prompt caching cuts repeat-prefix cost on all three providers.
